incident_updates.body: We have determined the origin of the incident affecting our Domains, customers in the impacted zone are unable to perform some tasks. Here is detail for this incident : Start time : 07/04/2026 06:30 UTC Impacted Service(s) : Multiple operations (Registration, Renew, Transfer, Restore, Delete) are temporarily unavailable for .DK domains. Customers Impact : Customers are temporarily unable to perform multiple operations (Registration, Renew, Transfer, Restore, Delete). Please note that websites are still available. Unfortunately, customers who want to renew their .DKdomains name after the expiration date is already passed will have their websites unavailable. Root Cause : This incident is caused by our provider. Ongoing Actions : The incident has been identified and our teams are mobilised to restore service as quickly as possible. Our teams are fully engaged and working to resolve the issue as quickly as possible. We will keep you updated on the progress and resolution. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
